summary: Retested public health API and DigiLib desktop/mobile flows. Health, catalog search/filter, detail/login/borrow/profile, admin rendering, mobile navigation, and 390px overflow checks passed.

integration_issues.flow: Google Sheets/Apps Script synchronization and authentication
integration_issues.issue: UI still uses local catalog/loan state and accepts any credentials; the displayed Google Sheets sync status is not backed by an Apps Script request.

action_items: Replace MOCKED local catalog, authentication, and borrowing with configured Google Apps Script/Sheets/Drive integration before production.
Enforce role/session checks for the publicly reachable admin navigation when real authentication is enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin navigation is currently publicly accessible without role/session enforcement; acceptable only as an explicitly MOCKED prototype.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing local demo catalog and loan seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health endpoint and responsive fixes from iteration 1 are verified. Real Apps Script integration, persistence, return/reservation, and role-based admin access remain untested/unimplemented.
test_credentials: Used demo@unesa.ac.id / demo123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; login is MOCKED and accepts any values.
rca of the issue: No current functional regression found. Remaining integration gap is structural: App.js defines hardcoded books and in-memory loan state, while the Apps Script URL/configuration is not consumed by the frontend; LoginModal invokes a local callback without validating inputs.
